name: Codex Draggable Decorations
instruction: Implement scenes/draggable.tscn as a decoration component that can be dragged. The root Area2D must be named Draggable in the scene, set collision_mask to 2, linear_damp to 20, and attach scripts/draggable.gd. Under it, add Sprite2D named Sprite that uses assets/sprites/star_1.png and is uniformly scaled to 0.58, plus a CollisionShape2D named CollisionShape that holds a 72×72 RectangleShape2D covering the sprite. Implement scripts/draggable.gd so it records initial_position and initial_scale on _ready(), shrinks to zero and tweens back in play_spawn_animation(), listens for the "click" action in _on_input_event/_input, lerps toward the mouse while dragging, emits dropped(self, overlapping_areas) on release, and calls self_destruct() with a shrink tween whenever it is dropped outside DropTarget's region.

metadata.tutorial_source: YouTube: Cashew OldDew - Master Drag and Drop with Tree Systems in Godot
metadata.transcript_excerpt: [L157-214] "a decoration is simply an area ... initialize the texture, initial position, initial scale and also a spawn animation ... place some animations on spawn and on self-destruct"
